# Crates

Generated by `conductor-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 2 packages. None is on a registry; build them from the repository. The domain types live in `crates/conductor-model`, which `ess` generates from `spec/` and which is outside the workspace.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conductor-cli` | [`crates/conductor`](https://github.com/beyond10x/conductor/tree/main/crates/conductor) | `use conductor_cli`, binary `conductor` | The conductor command line: the `cli:` block of spec/components.yaml, in clap derive form. |
| `conductor-docs` | [`crates/conductor-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/conductor/tree/main/crates/conductor-docs) | `use conductor_docs`, binary `conductor-docs` | Generates the derived pages of the conductor documentation site (CLI, config, crates, status) and checks them for drift. |
